video_title: “We Pride Ourselves On Defense.” | Jaden McDaniels Postgame Sound | 11.21.26

quotes.speaker: Jaden McDaniels
quotes.summary_phrase: Jaden McDaniels on LaMelo Ball's defensive effort and intensity
quotes.excerpt: the effort and energy he gives is way better than the LaMelo we used to play against
quotes.quote: He is doing a good job. He is pressuring people, running people off the spot. I think the effort and energy he gives is way better than the LaMelo we used to play against. He actually played defense, he is taking pride in his effort and stuff. I think I just said it for real.
quotes.social_post: Jaden McDaniels says LaMelo Ball has evolved defensively: He is pressuring people and taking pride in his effort. It is way better than the LaMelo we used to play against.

structured.context: Jaden McDaniels discusses the defensive intensity and effort shown by LaMelo Ball during their recent matchup.

quotes.speaker: Jaden McDaniels
quotes.summary_phrase: Jaden McDaniels on LaMelo Ball's defensive evolution
quotes.excerpt: he really didn't have to play defense, but here he has to
quotes.quote: I think LaMelo really didn't have to play defense, but here he has to. If you don't, people are just going to put you in the action. I feel like when they do put him in the action, he holds his own. He fights, it is not an easy bucket every time someone is guarding someone, so it is just good to see that he has the effort on defense.
quotes.social_post: Jaden McDaniels on LaMelo Ball's defensive growth: He really did not have to play defense before, but here he has to. If you do not, people are just going to put you in the action.

structured.context: Jaden McDaniels explains how LaMelo Ball has improved his defensive accountability and ability to hold his own in defensive actions.

quotes.social_post: Jaden McDaniels on the Timberwolves defensive identity: If you do not play defense here you are not going to play, so it is simple for real.

structured.context: Jaden McDaniels describes the defensive expectations and accountability required to earn playing time for the Minnesota Timberwolves.

quotes.summary_phrase: Jaden McDaniels on his growth in work ethic
quotes.excerpt: the work ethic I feel like has jumped way more
quotes.quote: I have always been like that, but the work ethic I feel like has jumped way more. Learning the league and how things work and how much work you need to put in and what days you need to take off and take care of your body. It is seven years, it has worked up, getting better each year.

quotes.speaker: Jaden McDaniels
quotes.summary_phrase: Jaden McDaniels on balancing aggression and team play
quotes.excerpt: staying aggressive when I am in the action and then if it is not able to score
quotes.quote: Staying aggressive when I am in the action and then if it is not able to score, just knowing where my outlets are and then trusting my teammates with the ball that they are going to make the right play and then eventually I will get the ball back. So just staying confident, staying aggressive and I know I am going to make the right play.
quotes.social_post: Jaden McDaniels on his offensive approach: Staying aggressive when I am in the action and then if it is not able to score, just knowing where my outlets are and then trusting my teammates with the ball.

quotes.summary_phrase: Jaden McDaniels on defensive chemistry with Jaden McDaniels
quotes.excerpt: I always be saying I didn't know he could play defense like this before he came
